_note: Directories under backend/ holding content that reaches PRERENDERED reader
pages. Three things read this list, and they must agree or the reader ships
1. library/content_fixtures.py: content_digest() — the fingerprint the API
2. frontend/scripts/await-api-release.mjs — the prebuild gate that waits
for the API to hold this build's content before prerendering.
3. render.yaml's ochorus-web buildFilter — which commits rebuild the
reader at all. tests_fixture pins that it covers every root here.
An entry is a directory, or a single FILE where a directory would sweep
in build artifacts — the two seed modules are Python, and a directory of
Python grows a __pycache__ the moment anything imports it.
A source of reader content that is NOT listed here never rebuilds the
reader: its pages keep the previous prose until some unrelated commit
happens to trigger a build. That is exactly how plan and topic prose went
stale after they moved out of seed_plans.py into data/.
_reader_exempt_note: Modules the serializers import that carry NO reader prose, so a change to
them cannot stale a prerendered page. Every module reachable from
library/serializers.py must be either a root above or listed here with a
reason — ContentSourceCoverageTests enforces it, so a NEW content-bearing
module cannot join the graph unclassified. That is the hole this closes:
curated_art.py reached the serializers on 2026-08-22 and was declared
nowhere, and #1150 prerendered six pages with no artwork credit.

reader_exempt.library/models.py: Schema and queries. The prose is ROWS, shipped as fixtures; the only computed properties are chapter_count and is_live, both counts. Every commit here in the last 300 was an index or a query shape.
reader_exempt.library/fts.py: Search vectors. Search is a runtime query against the API — no static page bakes a result.
reader_exempt.library/text.py: HTML to plain text for Chapter.body_text, which feeds search rather than any rendered page.
reader_exempt.library/translation.py: The translate pipeline. What it produces ships as fixture rows under library/fixtures/content, which is already a root.
reader_exempt.library/contemporize.py: The modern-English pipeline. The serializers take only its MODERN_LANGUAGE key; the prose itself ships as fixture rows.
reader_exempt.library/localization.py: Resolves which language a request asked for. Routing, not prose.
reader_exempt.library/languages.py: The Language registry accessor. The registry's DATA is DB-owned (an admin can add a language without a deploy) and seeded from language_seed.py; which locales are live reaches the build through fetch-live-locales.mjs, not through this digest.
